user_problem: A fixed offline archive needs a human-readable finding aid based solely on supplied folder and item descriptions.
unique_output: A hierarchical finding aid with series, date span, item scope, identifiers, access notes, and uncertain placement.
required_input: Archive inventory, folder descriptions, dates, identifiers, supplied hierarchy rules, and access annotations.
critical_rule: Do not invent missing contents or reorganize the archive; uncertain items remain in an explicit unclassified section.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is taxonomy-structure-check; this describes an archive for discovery rather than validating parent-child graph structure.
acceptance_scenario: Input folders F1 '2025 meeting agendas' and F2 '2025 invoices,' plus item X '2025 notes' without folder rule. Output creates Meetings and Finance series entries and lists X as unclassified.
